description: Returns what was recorded since a date (default 7 days, up to 90): SEC filings accepted, figures a company restated, technical signals, and ownership declarations. By default (`highlights`) ranked by materiality — restatements, earnings, agreements, offerings and sizeable insider purchases first, signals last — with repeats grouped (a company's insider filings of one kind with their total, a manager's 13F); `detail: 'events'` is the raw list, newest first. Use it for a daily or weekly brief, or when the user asks what changed. Price moves are not events here (see get_company). A 13D/G row's `move`: crossed 5%, up, down, below 5% (no longer required to report, not a sale) or out; a 13F row's `moves`: what that manager did since its previous quarter; an amended 13F says so. `complete: false`: the answer is complete after `coversFrom`; pass `next.until` as `until` for the page before (an event at that exact instant can appear on both pages: deduplicate by accession), or pass `symbol`.

detail.description: 'highlights' (default): ranked, grouped summary of the window. 'events': the raw list, newest first.

limit.description: Highlights: rows to return (default 40, max 100). Events: events to return (default 50, max 200).

since.description: ISO date or timestamp to look back from (default: 7 days ago, maximum 90 days).

symbol.description: Restrict to one ticker. Omit for the whole universe.

until.description: ISO date or timestamp to read up to, included (default: now). Pass the previous answer's `next.until` to read the next page.

name: what_changed
title: Events since a date
